description: archi-magic: (1) add the short archi-magic rules block (hooks/session-rules.md) to every session, local file read only; (2) at startup, show a one-line notice when a newer archi-magic release exists (hooks/update-check.ps1: at most one GitHub release call per day, cached; when stale it also names the skills the installed copy does not have, from a local copy or one cached GitHub call per release; opt out with ARCHI_MAGIC_NO_UPDATE_CHECK=1); (3) at session end, scan the transcript tail for trouble (hooks/session-end-feedback.ps1: Revit connection errors, failed tool calls, the user saying something is broken) and save a one-line note; at the next session start, show it once and offer to file it as a GitHub issue (hooks/session-start-feedback.ps1). Quiet sessions stay quiet; opt out with ARCHI_MAGIC_NO_FEEDBACK_NUDGE=1. Windows PowerShell, no Git Bash needed. Never blocks the session.
